bagPolicy.summary: No bags are permitted in PPG Paints Arena, with exceptions for medical bags, diaper bags, and small wristlets or wallets. All exceptions are subject to inspection.
allowed: Wristlets or Wallets (no larger than 4" x 6" x 1.5")
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medical bags, diaper bags, and small wristlets or wallets, all subject to inspection.

parking.note: Parking is available in the PPG Paints Arena Lots and the Parking Garage at PPG Paints Arena for non-hockey events. All lots are cashless, and pre-purchasing parking in advance is encouraged through ParkWhiz. Event parking rates vary.
lots: Parking Garage at PPG Paints Arena

rideshare.note: As the Official Rideshare Partner of PPG Paints Arena, Lyft offers a discount code PPGPAINTS for 50% off your first 2 rides (up to $10/ride).

concessions.note: PPG Paints Arena offers a variety of food and beverage options to enhance the event experience. While specific offerings may vary by event, guests can expect a range of traditional and specialty concessions. Highlights often include local favorites and unique culinary experiences.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by PPG Paints Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exit and re-entry is not permitted at PPG Paints Arena. Exit and re-entry into the building is not permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets ordered or prepaid can be picked up at the DICK'S Sporting Goods Box Office at PPG Paints Arena, located in the lobby.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The Highmark Gate is located next to the Epiphany Catholic Church on Centre Avenue and is the main entryway to PPG Paints Arena and home to the famous Mario Lemieux Statue.
